name: Winged Boots

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Fly
powers.text: Bonus Action: a Fly Speed equal to your Speed, up to 4 hours a day.

summary: Fly at your Speed for up to 4 hours a day.
text: Wearing these boots, you can fly, with a Fly Speed matching your Speed. They hold 4 hours of flight, which you can use in one stretch or split across several flights, though each flight uses up at least 1 minute. If the time runs out while you are airborne, you sink 30 feet each round until you reach the ground. For every 12 hours the boots go unused, they recover 2 hours of flight.
